a code change carrying only a docs/BUGS/ row still owes a history entry
ci verify on PR 194 reports no core/history-entry finding
diagnosis: Reproduced with ci verify --base origin/main --head HEAD on PR 194: 70 core/history-entry findings, one per non-record file, although the range adds docs/HISTORY/2026-11-08.md entries. Root cause is historyEntryReal in records-history-guards.ts (changed by d31aa56, T-0016): it now filters record files out and flags every remaining file, so a docs/HISTORY/ file in scope no longer exempts the change; the intended narrowing was only that a docs/BUGS/ row alone must not exempt a code change. Fix lets a docs/HISTORY/ file in scope exempt the change while a BUGS-only record still does not.
